WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4),
prev AS (SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=4),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.store_id FROM dim_store st, cur, prev
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date < prev.period_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date > cur.period_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
      AND ((c.closure_start_date <= cur.period_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= cur.period_start_date)
        OR (c.closure_start_date <= prev.period_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= prev.period_start_date)))),
sales AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prev' END AS p, sum(f.net_amount) AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key, cur, prev
  WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
    AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date OR f.sale_date BETWEEN prev.period_start_date AND prev.period_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prev' END AS p, sum(r.refund_net) AS v
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key, cur, prev
  WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
    AND (r.return_date BETWEEN cur.period_start_date AND cur.period_end_date OR r.return_date BETWEEN prev.period_start_date AND prev.period_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round(100.0 * ((sc.v - rc.v) / (sp.v - rp.v) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lfl_stores) AS nstores, sc.v - rc.v AS cur_ns, sp.v - rp.v AS prev_ns
FROM sales sc JOIN sales sp ON sc.p='cur' AND sp.p='prev' JOIN rets rc ON rc.p='cur' JOIN rets rp ON rp.p='prev'
